cohort: 215 IVF patients who delivered in the Singapore General Hospital
finding: Among a cohort of IVF patients, multiple pregnancy was the primary driver of cesarean section, followed by planned cesarean section and failed induction in term singleton pregnancies and preterm singleton pregnancies.
mod_finding: Multiple pregnancy was the primary contributor to cesarean section in the IVF population studied, while among singleton pregnancies, planned cesarean section, failed induction, and preterm births were the next largest contributors.
